blocks.text: Cloverdale Farms: what the ground is and what governs it

items.t: Live-page editorial scope (site copy, not adopted as fact): the page describes Cloverdale's agricultural belt as spanning the Serpentine and Nicomekl lowlands west of 176 Street and south of Highway 10, with hobby farms near 168 Street / 40 Avenue and larger berry, nursery, forage and vegetable operations.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect acreage buyers

items.t: Suites / coach houses: Surrey's urban rule is one secondary suite per single-family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit, at most 40% of the principal unit's habitable floor area, never inside a coach house or garden suite and not a separate strata lot; coach houses / garden suites run 35–75 m² (up to 120 m² on RA, R2, R2-O and R3 lots below maximum FAR) with one extra parking space. On ALR land the ALC rule above is the stricter frame (suite inside the principal residence only). Whether a Surrey coach house can serve as the ALR "additional residence" on a given parcel is a parcel-level ALC + City check: unconfirmed as a general rule. Surrey SSMUH (3 / 4 / up to 6 units by lot band, Jul 8, 2024) is an urban-lot framework — it is not a route to extra dwellings on ALR farm parcels.

The page's farm-class summary understates the rule it summarizes: "$2,500 to $10,000+" flattens a three-tier test whose middle tier is a formula ($2,500 plus 5% of value over 4 ha) — a mid-size operation priced on the flat summary will misstate its qualification income.
Flood and servicing: On Serpentine lowland ground those are per-parcel City and title checks, not page facts — budget the diligence, not the copy.

faq.q: Can a suite go in a barn or a detached building on a Cloverdale farm?
faq.a: No — under the ALC housing rules a secondary suite is permitted only inside the principal residence; a detached second dwelling is the "additional residence," which is size-capped under the 90 m² / 186 m² limits.

faq.q: Can I Airbnb the farm house?
faq.a: Bed-and-breakfast use inside a lived-in principal residence is permitted within the ALC's four-bedroom / 30-day limits.

faq.q: How big can a house be on ALR farmland in Cloverdale?
faq.a: One principal residence per parcel is permitted without an ALC application at a maximum total floor area of 500 m², with no more than 1,000 m² of fill placed for its construction; anything larger requires ALC approval, and the City may regulate further.

faq.q: Is a second residence permitted on a Cloverdale ALR acreage?
faq.a: One additional detached residence may be permitted without an ALC application where the conditions are met — maximum 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less, or 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha — and City of Surrey bylaws must also permit it.

faq.q: Where are Cloverdale's farms, based on the live feed?
faq.a: The live cloverdale-farms feed's visible listings at reading were both labelled Serpentine and sit on 176 Street (Highway 15) — the feed as read is a Serpentine farm feed inside the wider Cloverdale community, whose City-described borders run along 160 Street (west) and 48 Avenue (south), with Langley to the east.
